subject.title: fix(slack): restore HTTP event processing after webhook acknowledgement

question: Should `runDetachedWebhookWork` become a supported public plugin SDK API for ack-first webhook integrations?
rationale: The Slack fix needs a core-owned admission capability, but exporting it through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/webhook-request-guards` creates a durable third-party compatibility contract that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve narrow SDK helper
options.body: Keep the generic helper in the existing webhook guard entrypoint and treat independent post-ack work admission as a supported plugin capability.

options.title: Use an internal injected seam
options.body: Avoid expanding the public SDK by injecting a host-owned continuation into the bundled Slack runtime through an internal facade.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a broader webhook lifecycle API covering acknowledgement, detached work, draining, and cancellation.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow SDK helper
recommendation.body: Keep the generic helper in the existing webhook guard entrypoint and treat independent post-ack work admission as a supported plugin capability.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both the Slack runtime and the existing webhook request-guard SDK seam.
